```{r}
source("./visual_fx.R")

con_ctc<- connect_to_db("cancel_the_contract")

df<-dbGetQuery(con_ctc, "SELECT * FROM analysis_graduation WHERE reportingcategory_re IN ('nh_black', 'latinx', 'nh_white', 'student__disability', 'total')")%>%
  select(-label)%>%
  rename("label"="reportingcategory_re")%>%
  race_sp()

indicator <- "Student graduation by race"

single_bar_tot_sp(df, indicator)

dbDisconnect(con_ctc)
```
